completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The NTSB attributed the accident to the airplane's degraded performance from high-density altitude and gusting wind conditions, which left it unable to maintain altitude during the initial takeoff climb. [20191020X24101:analysis] The airplane was also topped with fuel, likely putting it near its maximum allowable takeoff weight. [20191020X24101:analysis] Contributing factors were the pilot's lack of experience with high altitude flying and his decision to depart in high-density altitude and gusting wind conditions.
